name: facebook-ads-placement-location-and-device-breakdown
description: Use for "is Audience Network wasting my money", "should I turn off automatic placements", "how are Reels doing versus Feed", "which countries are working on Meta", "is mobile or desktop converting", "what time of day should I be running", or "where is my budget actually going" — even when the user never says "placement".
